title: 2x2 mesh, 4-node ALLREDUCE: independent RTL execution of the canonical trace

expected.notes: Two distinct claims. (1) workload_lowering_conservation: the ring ALLREDUCE oracle (independent arithmetic, no veritx_dse import) predicts messages=2k(k-1)=24, bytes=2(k-1)B=48, chunk=B/k=2, flits=24, packets=24; VERITX's lowering must match BEFORE any simulator runs. (2) The RTL independently EXECUTES the trace VERITX derived from that lowering (it cannot validate the lowering itself). The RTL completion is calibrated to BookSim, so rtl_completion is semi-independent.
